messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "tell doctor about all other heart or blood pressure medications"
set: ["tell doctor about all other heart or blood pressure medications", "tell doctor about all medications", "tell doctor about all prescription medications", "tell doctor about all over-the-counter medications", "tell doctor or pharmacist about all other medicines", "inform doctor or pharmacist if taking other heart or blood pressure medications", "tell doctor about all medical conditions", "blood pressure or heart rate", "other medicines that lower blood pressure or heart rate", "tell your doctor about all current medicines", "other blood pressure medicines", "especially heart or blood pressure medication", "heart problems or high blood pressure", "tell doctor about history of heart disease", "tell your doctor about all medicines you use", "inform doctor or pharmacist about all medications currently taken or recently stopped taking"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
